WITH type_counts AS (
  SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.ordertune
), averages AS (
  SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count
  FROM type_counts
)
SELECT AVG(tc.order_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(tc.order_count - a.avg_count) AS average_excess
FROM type_counts AS tc
CROSS JOIN averages AS a
WHERE tc.order_count > a.avg_count;
